sign.cert.title: Certificate
sign.cert.passwordNote: The password is used only in this window and is never saved.
sign.cert.subject: Signer

sign.cert.eku: This certificate is not meant for signing documents.
sign.cert.cannotSign: This certificate can’t be used to sign.
sign.place.title: Placement
sign.place.drawHint: Drag on the page to draw the signature box.
sign.place.invisibleNote: The signature is stored in the file without anything drawn on the pages.
sign.ap.title: Appearance
sign.ap.name: Name shown
sign.kind.title: Signature type
sign.lock.all: Lock all form fields after signing
sign.level.title: Level
sign.level.B-LT: With a timestamp and revocation data for long-term validation (PAdES B-LT).
sign.level.B-LTA: Long-term validation plus a document timestamp (PAdES B-LTA).
sign.level.desktopOnly: Timestamps and long-term validation need the ZOOD PDF desktop app.
sign.tsa.label: Timestamp authority (address)
sign.tsa.invalid: Enter an address that starts with http:// or https://
sign.tsa.note: When you click Sign, ZOOD PDF sends only a fingerprint of the signature to this address.
sign.tsa.noteLtv: When you click Sign, ZOOD PDF sends a fingerprint of the signature to this address and asks the servers named in the certificate whether it is revoked.
sign.incremental: The signature is added to the end of the file; the original content stays untouched.
sign.ltvPartial: Revocation data couldn’t be fetched for: {names}
sig.panel.title: Signatures
sig.tsa.untrusted: verified, authority not in your trust list
sig.identity.trusted: Trusted (chains to a certificate you trust)
sig.identity.unknown: Unknown — add the issuer to your trusted certificates to confirm it
sig.mods.title: {count, plural, one {# change after signing} other {# changes after signing}}
sig.mods.disallowedNote: Some changes are not allowed by this signature: the document is no longer as signed.
sig.trust.title: Trusted certificates
sig.trust.note: Signer identities are confirmed only against certificates you add here. ZOOD PDF trusts none by default.
sig.reason.identity_unknown: The signer’s certificate doesn’t chain to a certificate you trust.
sig.reason.certificate_expired: The signer’s certificate was not valid at signing time.
sig.reason.certificate_revoked: The signer’s certificate has been revoked.
sig.reason.certificate_not_for_document_: The certificate is not meant for signing documents.
sig.reason.byte_range_invalid: The signed byte range is malformed.
sig.reason.byte_range_not_from_start: The signature doesn’t cover the file from its start.
sig.reason.byte_range_not_at_revision_en: The signature doesn’t end at a saved version of the file.
sig.reason.contents_not_in_gap: The signature value is not where the byte range says.
sig.reason.contents_outside_signature_ob: The signature value lies outside its signature object.
sig.reason.signature_not_in_signed_revis: The signature belongs to other content (borrowed signature).
sig.reason.signed_revision_unreadable: The signed version can’t be read.
sig.reason.unsupported_sub_filter: This signature format is not supported.
sig.reason.no_signing_certificate_attrib: The signature doesn’t name its certificate securely.
sig.reason.timestamp_authority_unknown: The timestamp authority is not trusted.
sig.reason.trailing_data: There is data after the end of the file.
sig.reason.signature_in_object_stream: The signature is stored in an unusual way.
sig.reason.signing_time_attribute: The signature carries its own signing time (not used by PAdES).
sig.reason.limit_exceeded: The file is too complex to check completely.
sig.attack.shadow_hide: Shadow attack: content hidden when signed was revealed later.
sig.attack.shadow_replace: Shadow attack: signed content was replaced.
sig.attack.shadow_hide_and_replace: Shadow attack: the page was switched to other content.
sig.attack.overlay: Something was drawn over the signed page after signing.
sig.attack.incremental_saving: Content was changed in a later save.
sig.attack.signature_wrapping: Signature wrapping: the signed bytes were rearranged.
sig.attack.borrowed_signature: Borrowed signature: it was copied from another document.
sig.attack.xref_manipulation: The file’s object table was manipulated.
sig.attack.trailing_data: Data was appended after the end of the file.
